Could AI trigger the next wave of wallet drains? 😳

Ethereum Foundation researcher Justin Drake is calling for the industry to prepare for ''bunker mode''

What does that mean for your wallet?
What’s the risk, and how can you reduce it?

What are Drake and Vitalik actually recommending? 👇

> The risk

AI could potentially discover a way to recover private keys from public keys. That would let attackers sign transfers without your seed phrase.

> Why public keys matter

For a standard Ethereum wallet, an outgoing transaction exposes its public key through the signature. Message signatures can expose it too.

> Drake’s proposal

Keep long-term holdings at fresh addresses whose keys have never signed anything.

A hidden public key adds a barrier under this scenario. It doesn’t make the underlying cryptography stronger.

Today I call upon the blockchain industry to calmly begin planning for "bunker mode". My personal recommendation is to set in motion a controlled mass migration of assets to fresh addresses, i.e. addresses whose pubkeys remain hidden behind a hash.

Holders, starting with large and sophisticated ones, should consider moving the bulk of their funds to addresses that have never signed a transaction. And when they do sign one, they should also move remaining funds to a new address (possibly generated from the same seed phrase).

Don't rush. While I believe there is cause for action a rushed migration would do more harm than good. Don't panic either. Moving assets to protected addresses is a simple, preventative step which does not require new cryptography or new wallets.
